errors.evidence: The chart displays six distinct lines, not five. The description lists five colored lines and then adds the dashed black line separately, but it is one of the six main series.
For the maroon line ("Wohnbauten"), the minimum value of approximately 47% is reached around the year 2015, not 2007. In 2007, the value is approximately 52%.
The maroon line ("Wohnbauten") ends at a value of approximately 51.5% in 2023, not 54%.
The green line ("Tiefbau") has a value of approximately 58% in 2005, not 54%. It does not reach 54% until around 2017.
After 2005, the green line ("Tiefbau") continues on a clear downward trend; it does not remain stable.
The light purple line ("Geistiges Eigentum") ends at a value of approximately 52.5% in 2023, not 54%.
The dashed black line ("Staat insgesamt") ends at a value of approximately 50.5% in 2023, not 52%.
